extractionBoundary: SwitchInClearSetData, FaintClearSetData, Cmd_cleareffectsonfaint and Cmd_checkteamslost retain complete original source function bodies.

Only the complete ENDTURN_POISON and ENDTURN_BURN case blocks from DoBattlerEndTurnEffects are copied into SpikeSourceResidualCase. The enclosing full scheduler and its other effect cases are not implemented by this wrapper.

Poison/Burn script symbols are identity markers; the adapter transports their original healthbar/datahp command path with passive-damage flags. It does not execute text, animation, full faint/replacement scripts or end2 callbacks.
Party HP/species/egg access for Cmd_checkteamslost uses explicitly projected in-memory party records. It is not original encrypted Pokemon storage or persistence.

FaintClearSetData reads its unchanged source type-restoration expression from a projected three-row SpeciesInfo array. Synthetic actor + 1 indices store admitted baseline fixture types; they are not source species IDs or the source species database.

Party presence tokens and fixture HP are validated before storage. Eligible side HP totals above 65535 reject instead of overflowing the original Cmd_checkteamslost u16 accumulator; this admits all real Gen III totals but not every synthetic u16-per-mon stress state.

hostObligations.finding: Original switch commands obtain and copy a BattlePokemon controller buffer, restore source types and ability, handle item state, then invoke SwitchInClearSetData. This probe transports admitted incoming records in its private host; it does not execute the full storage/controller/switch script path.

Legal replacements are living nonempty non-egg party records other than the current active slot. Source wrap, escape-prevention and rooted restrictions must reject or be implemented. HasNoMonsToSwitch returns FALSE early for singles and is not a singles legality implementation.

The source action-finish path processes faint replacements before normal end-turn effects. Its singles replacement script cancels all remaining actions. A bounded host must pause for a legal replacement after an attack KO, prevent the replacement from inheriting the defeated actor action, and only then continue the pending residual phase.

Each ordered residual invokes faint handling and checkteamslost immediately. Terminal outcome stops subsequent residual processing. When a reserve exists, residual replacement choices follow completion of the residual effects phase, unlike the action KO replacement pause.

DoFieldEndTurnEffects calls GetWhoStrikesFirst with FALSE, so selected move priority participates in residual ordering. Preserve that argument and its speed-tie RNG draw; do not substitute a speed-only or player-first comparator.

An action-selection-start Random draw is stored as gRandomTurnNumber at initial setup and after each continuing turn. This is additional to attack accuracy, critical, damage, secondary-effect and speed-tie RNG. Neither burn nor ordinary poison residual arithmetic draws RNG.

The complete poison/burn cases compute integer maxHP / 8 with minimum one only for a living affected battler. Healthbar/datahp commands need IGNORE_SUBSTITUTE, PASSIVE_DAMAGE, GRUDGE and SKIP_DMG_TRACK as selected by the original scheduler/script path; stale move-result immunity flags must be cleared first. Do not run attack type, critical, damage-randomization or damage-history paths.

Cmd_cleareffectsonfaint clears status1 and emits a status update before complete FaintClearSetData. This does not implement Cmd_tryfaintmon, faint counters, friendship, experience, Destiny Bond/Grudge or the full replacement script. Those remain excluded or explicit host obligations.

Cmd_checkteamslost sums each full six-slot party eligible HP using u16; nonempty eggs are ignored. Player zero gives LOST=2, enemy zero gives WON=1, both give DREW=3. Active battler HP alone cannot decide outcome. Projected party setter rejects eligible totals above 65535 before mutation so synthetic stress fixtures cannot overflow this source sum.

Primary status application requires its original common guards, case and shared statusChanged tail; setting a fixture status bit is initialization only. Cmd_seteffectwithchance uses Random()%100 <= percentChance and evaluates that draw before testing a zero effect byte. Preserve the source comparison and evaluation order.
